SELECT MIN(y.Date) AS first_month, MAX(y.Date) AS last_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT y.Date) AS months, COUNT(*) AS monthly_rows,
       COUNT(y.Consumption) AS known_values, MIN(y.Consumption) AS minimum_consumption,
       SUM(y.Consumption = 0) AS zero_months,
       (SELECT MIN(t.Date) FROM main.transactions_1k AS t) AS first_transaction,
       (SELECT MAX(t.Date) FROM main.transactions_1k AS t) AS last_transaction
FROM main.yearmonth AS y
WHERE y.Date >= '201201' AND y.Date < '201301'

arguments.sql:
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT y.CustomerID
    FROM main.yearmonth AS y
    WHERE y.Date >= '201201' AND y.Date < '201301'
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(y.Consumption) < 30000
)
SELECT c.Segment, COUNT(q.CustomerID) AS customer_count
FROM main.customers AS c
LEFT JOIN qualifying_customers AS q ON q.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY c.Segment
